manifest.name: dsh-voice-space
manifest.description: Hold Space to talk in DeepSeek Harness — local SenseVoice transcription (streams sentence-by-sentence while you hold) with automatic polish on release. 按住空格键语音输入：长按录音、逐句实时出字，松手后自动校对优化。
manifest.author: Miaoqing He

bundle.text:
# dsh-voice-space bundle patch: registers the no-op host entry so this package
# mounts as a profile bundle and its client half (exports "./client") is served
# into the web GUI. All behaviour lives in the client; transcription is delegated
# to the dsh-voice-local host routes at runtime.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-voice-space
      name: dsh-voice-space

readme.text:
**Hold Space to talk** in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Long-press the Space bar in the chat input to record; the transcript **streams in sentence by sentence** while you hold, and on release it's **automatically polished** (homophones fixed, filler words removed, punctuation tidied) before landing at the caret. Fully **local transcription** — audio never leaves your machine, no STT API key required.

[English](#features) · [中文](#功能)

---

- **Hold-to-talk**: hold `Space` (≥ 450 ms) in the composer to start recording; release to stop. A quick tap still types a normal space.
- **Live streaming**: sentences appear in the floating panel as you speak (silence-based segmentation, ~0.6 s after each pause).
- **Auto polish on release**: the full transcript is sent through DeepSeek once and cleaned up — ASR homophone errors corrected, filler words (`嗯/呃/那个/就是/然后`) dropped, punctuation fixed — **without changing the meaning**. Falls back to the raw transcript if the API/key/network is unavailable.
- **IME-safe**: the Space used to confirm Chinese IME candidates is never intercepted.
- **Local STT**: SenseVoice (sherpa-onnx, CPU) runs inside the plugin's own host half. No `dsh-voice-local` required.
- **Esc to cancel**; focus loss cancels cleanly.

- **按住说话**：输入框内长按空格（≥450ms）开始录音，松手结束；轻点空格仍是普通空格。
- **实时出字**：说话时按静音断句，每个短句约 0.6 秒后实时显示在悬浮面板里。
- **松手自动校准**：松开后全文交给 DeepSeek 校对一次——修同音字错别字、删填充词、补标点，**不改变原意**；接口/Key/网络不可用时自动退回原始转写。
- **中文输入法安全**：选词用的空格不被拦截。
- **本地转写**：SenseVoice（sherpa-onnx，CPU）在插件自己的宿主端运行，无需安装 dsh-voice-local。
- **Esc 取消**；窗口失焦自动取消。

---

> Requires DeepSeek Harness with the desktop / web profile (`platform: web` client). Tested on the Windows desktop app (`dsh 0.2.1-rc.5`).

```bash

readme.section: or from a local clone / path
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:<absolute path to this repo>"
```

Then **fully quit and reopen** DeepSeek Harness (a page refresh is not enough in the packaged app).

The SenseVoice model (`model.int8.onnx` + `tokens.txt`, ~230 MB) is downloaded automatically on first use into `~/.dsh/voice/sensevoice/` (or `$DSH_HOME/voice/sensevoice/`), fetched from Hugging Face mirrors. You can also pre-place those two files there to skip the download.

The release-time polish uses your configured `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`, resolved from the DSH credentials seam at request time — it never touches the browser or the plugin cache. Without a key, the raw transcript is inserted as-is.

---

1. Click into the main composer.
2. Hold `Space` for ~0.5 s → the panel shows `正在聆听…（松开空格结束，Esc 取消）`.
3. Speak; the transcript streams into the panel.
4. Release → brief `正在校准优化…` → polished text is inserted at the caret.

---

```
hold Space (client keydown)
   └─ AudioWorklet records 16 kHz mono PCM (silence segmenter)
        └─ POST /dsh-voice-space/v1/transcribe  (per sentence)
             └─ pure-JS WAV decode → sherpa-onnx SenseVoice → text

The draft is written through the host's React-controlled channel (`inputActions.setDraft` via the `conversation.input.left` slot), so undo/history and the send gesture keep working.

| Method | Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/health` | native module + model status |
| GET | `/model/status` | model files + download state |
| POST | `/model/download` | start background model download |
| POST | `/transcribe` | WAV body → `{ ok, text }` |
| POST | `/polish` | `{ text }` → `{ ok, text }` |
| GET/POST | `/diag` | client lifecycle beacons (debugging) |

> WAV decoding is done in pure JS on purpose: in Electron the request body arrives as an "external" ArrayBuffer and sherpa-onnx's native `readWaveFromBinary` (zero-copy) throws `External buffers are not allowed`.

---

- Disable: in the console run `window.__dshVoiceSpace.disable()` (writes `dsh-voice-space:enabled=0` to localStorage); `enable()` to restore.
- State: `window.__dshVoiceSpace.recording`, `.inputReady`.

---

- Audio is transcribed locally and is never written to disk or sent to any STT service.
- The polish step sends only the (already local) transcript text to `api.deepseek.com`.
- The API key is resolved server-side from the DSH credentials seam and never enters the browser.
